# QRCoder

TabLink 0.6.0 uses QRCoder 1.6.0 to generate local pairing QR codes. License: MIT, see LICENSE.txt.

Upstream: https://github.com/codebude/QRCoder

NuGet package: QRCoder 1.6.0; package repository commit `bd980577640c47f8bb881cf24c8443415a579d36`.

License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codebude/QRCoder/bd980577640c47f8bb881cf24c8443415a579d36/LICENSE.txt

No pairing link, token, certificate, device identity, or display content is sent to the QR library's upstream server. QR generation runs locally.
